question_answers.answer: A client sends an HTTP request to a route; the service validates it, applies business logic, reads or writes the database, and returns a status and response body.

question_answers.question: How would you design a system for high availability and scalability?

pipeline_observations.finding: HR interview scores are tightly clustered across varied profiles.
pipeline_observations.interpretation: The deterministic HR heuristics produce similar outputs even when resume and technical evidence differ. Treat this stage as a conversation aid, not a reliable ranking signal.

pipeline_observations.finding: A limited-evidence profile receives a relatively high screening score.
pipeline_observations.interpretation: The configured screening rubric also rewards clarity and consistency, so its aggregate score can remain high when job-skill evidence is limited. Compare it with ATS, interview, and human-reviewed evidence.

performance.measurement_note: One local synthetic run. Model initialization and any first-use download affect timings; this is not a production benchmark.

limitations: Resume upload and parser integration are represented by pre-structured synthetic JSON; this runner does not exercise a production upload endpoint.
